advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the eXtensible ARchive (XAR) GZIP file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to exceed the configured MaxFileSize and cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
  
 This vulnerability is due to inefficiencies when parsing specifically formatted files with the XAR GZIP file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted XAR GZIP file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to effectively cause the ClamAV to exceed the MaxFileSize and potentially get caught in an infinite loop, causing a DoS condition.
advisories.summary: Microsoft reports this CVE in its monthly security update. Consult the preserved source for details.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the Object Linking and Embedding, 2nd Generation (OLE2) file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to exceed the configured MaxScanTime and cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
  
 This vulnerability is due to inefficiencies when parsing specifically formatted files with the OLE2 file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted Microsoft Compound File Binary (CFB) file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to effectively cause the ClamAV OLE2 parser to get into an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
advisories.summary: Microsoft reports this CVE in its monthly security update. Consult the preserved source for details.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the Ultimate Packer for eXecutables (UPX) unpacker of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
  
 This vulnerability is due to improper length checks, when unpacking the UPX files, which may result in an out-of-bounds read of heap memory. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted UPX for decode. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV decode process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
advisories.summary: Microsoft reports this CVE in its monthly security update. Consult the preserved source for details.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the debug logging functionality of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.

 This vulnerability is due to improper handling of logging values. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a file to be scanned by the software that has debug logging enabled. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
advisories.summary: Microsoft reports this CVE in its monthly security update. Consult the preserved source for details.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the LZX data algorithm for Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (CHM) file scanning in ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.

 This vulnerability is due to improper boundary checks when applying the LZX data algorithm to CHM files during the decoder stage, which may result in buffer overflow. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.
advisories.summary: Microsoft reports this CVE in its monthly security update. Consult the preserved source for details.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in Object Linking and Embedding, 2nd Generation (OLE2) file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.

 This vulnerability is due to logic error when parsing specifically formatted files with the OLE2 file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted Microsoft Compound File Binary (CFB) file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to allocate all available memory, causing the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the InstallShield file parser of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.

 This vulnerability is due to incomplete error checking when the InstallShield File Parser is performing a scan. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted InstallShield file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

advisories.title:
A vulnerability in the Yoda'a Crytper (yC) Portable Executable (PE) unpacker of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device. .

 This vulnerability is due to lack of proper error checking for negative values when processing the PE file to be unpacked. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a PE file to be unpacked. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

advisories.title: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

advisories.title: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

advisories.title: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

advisories.title: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

advisories.title: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

advisories.title: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

advisories.title: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

advisories.title: VMware ESXi OpenSLP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

advisories.title: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.

advisories.title: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

advisories.title: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

advisories.title: Unraid Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

advisories.title: Unraid Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.

advisories.title: TVT NVMS-1000 Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.product: Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan server contain a vulnerable EXE file that could allow a remote attacker to write data to a path on affected installations and bypass root login.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.product: Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Multiple Products Content Validation Escape Vulnerability
advisories.product: Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan contain an unspecified vulnerability within a migration tool component that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Trend Micro OfficeScan Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

advisories.title: ThinkPHP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ThinkPHP contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via public//?s=index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]= followed by the command.

advisories.title: ThinkPHP "noneCms" Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

advisories.title: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.

advisories.title: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

advisories.title: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

advisories.title: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

advisories.title: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

advisories.title: Symantec Messaging Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

advisories.title: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

advisories.title: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

advisories.title: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

advisories.title: SonicWall Email Security Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

advisories.title: SonicWall Email Security Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

advisories.title: SonicWall SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

advisories.title: SonicWall Email Security Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Sonatype Nexus Repository Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager allows for privilege escalation through leveraging a misconfiguration of sudo.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Serv-U Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Orion Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Orion API contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute API commands.

advisories.title: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.

advisories.title: SAP NetWeaver Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

advisories.title: SAP Solution Manager Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP Solution Manager User Experience Monitoring contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which results in complete compromise of all SMDAgents connected to the Solution Manager.

advisories.title: SAP NetWeaver Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access to execute configuration tasks and create administrative users.

advisories.title: SAP NetWeaver XML External Entity (XXE) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains an unspecified vulnerability in BC-BMT-BPM-DSK which allows remote, authenticated users to conduct XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

advisories.title: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.

advisories.title: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

advisories.title: SaltStack Salt Shell Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

advisories.title: SaltStack Salt Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

advisories.title: SaltStack Salt Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

advisories.title: Roundcube Webmail File Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Roundcube Webmail contains a file disclosure vulnerability caused by insufficient input validation in conjunction with file-based attachment plugins, which are used by default.

advisories.title: Realtek AP-Router SDK Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Realtek AP-Router SDK HTTP web server boa contains a buffer overflow vulnerability due to unsafe copies of some overly long parameters submitted in the form that lead to denial-of-service (DoS).

advisories.title: rConfig OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: rConfig lib/ajaxHandlers/ajaxAddTemplate.php contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via shell metacharacters in the fileName POST parameter.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm Chipsets contain a use after free vulnerability due to improper handling of memory mapping of multiple processes simultaneously.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Detection of Error Condition Without Action Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a detection of error condition without action vulnerability when improper handling of address deregistration on failure can lead to new GPU address allocation failure.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.product: Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a command injection vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to perform remote code execution via Windows File Resource Profiles.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker to perform code execution using uncontrolled gzip extraction.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Collaboration Suite Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Collaboration Suite contains a buffer overflow vulnerabilities that allows a remote authenticated users to execute code as the root user via maliciously crafted meeting room.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows an authenticated administrator to perform a file write via a maliciously crafted archive upload in the administrator web interface.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability in the admin web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to upload a custom template to perform code execution.

advisories.title: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

advisories.title: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

advisories.title: PlaySMS Server-Side Template Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability in the Console component with high impacts to confidentilaity, integrity, and availability.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability, which is assessed to allow for remote code execution, based on this vulnerability being related to CVE-2020-14750.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability is related to CVE-2020-14882.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS) Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

advisories.title: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle Fusion Middleware Reports Developer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality and integrity of affected systems.

advisories.title: Oracle Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Oracle products contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3 or HTTP to takeover the affected system. Impacted Oracle products: Oracle Coherence in Fusion Middleware, Oracle Utilities Framework, Oracle Retail Assortment Planning, Oracle Commerce, Oracle Communications Diameter Signaling Router (DSR).

advisories.title: Netis WF2419 Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

advisories.title: Netgear JGS516PE Devices Missing Function Level Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Netgear JGS516PE devices contain a missing function level access control vulnerability.

advisories.title: Nagios XI Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Nagios XI contains a remote code execution vulnerability in which a user can modify the check_plugin executable and insert malicious commands to execute as root.

advisories.title: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability due to incorrect alias information in the IonMonkey JIT compiler when setting array elements.

advisories.title: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when handling a ReadableStream under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts.

advisories.title: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a race condition vulnerability when running the nsDocShell destructor under certain conditions. The race condition creates a use-after-free vulnerability, causing unspecified impacts.

advisories.title: Microsoft Open Management Infrastructure (OMI) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Open Management Infrastructure (OMI) within Azure VM Management Extensions contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting (WER) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting (WER) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it handles files, allowing for code execution in kernel mode.

advisories.title: Microsoft Office OLE DLL Side Loading Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Office Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) dynamic link library (DLL) contains a side loading vulnerability due to it improperly validating input before loading libraries. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Privilege Common Log File System (CLFS) Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver improperly handles objects in memory which can allow for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft .NET Framework, SharePoint, and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft .NET Framework, Microsoft SharePoint, and Visual Studio contain a remote code execution vulnerability when the software fails to check the source markup of XML file input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in the context of the process responsible for deserialization of the XML content.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

advisories.title: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the component failing to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

advisories.title: Microsoft .NET Framework Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft .NET Framework contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint fails to check the source markup of an application package. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run remote code in the context of the SharePoint application pool and the SharePoint server farm account.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows CryptoAPI (Crypt32.dll) contains a spoofing vulnerability in the way it validates Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) certificates. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by using a spoofed code-signing certificate to sign a malicious executable, making it appear the file was from a trusted, legitimate source. A successful exploit could also allow the attacker to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks and decrypt confidential information on user connections to the affected software. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of CurveBall.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when the Windows kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in kernel mode.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability is part of the ProxyLogon exploit chain.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

advisories.title: Cisco Small Business RV320 and RV325 Routers Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.product: Small Business RV320 and RV325 Routers
advisories.summary: Cisco Small Business RV320 and RV325 Dual Gigabit WAN VPN Routers contain improper access controls for URLs. Exploitation could allow an attacker to download the router configuration or detailed diagnostic information.

advisories.title: Cisco IP Phones Web Server Remote Code Execution and Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IP Phones contain an improper input validation vulnerability for HTTP requests. Exploitation could allow an attacker to execute code remotely with root privileges or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS XR Software DVMRP Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS XR Distance Vector Multicast Routing Protocol (DVMRP) incorrectly handles Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) packets. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to immediately crash the IGMP process or make it consume available memory and eventually crash.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS XR Software DVMRP Memory Exhaustion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS XR Distance Vector Multicast Routing Protocol (DVMRP) incorrectly handles Internet Group Management Protocol (IGMP) packets. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to immediately crash the IGMP process or make it consume available memory and eventually crash.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS XR Software Discovery Protocol Format String Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS XR improperly validates string input from certain fields in Cisco Discovery Protocol messages. Exploitation could allow an unauthenticated, adjacent attacker to execute code with administrative privileges or cause a reload on an affected device.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software Smart Install Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software improperly validates packet data, allowing an unauthenticated, remote attacker to trigger a reload of an affected device, cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition, or perform code execution on the affected device.

advisories.title: Cisco HyperFlex HX Data Platform Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco HyperFlex HX Installer Virtual Machine contains an insufficient input validation vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute commands on an affected device as the tomcat8 user.

advisories.title: Cisco HyperFlex HX Installer Virtual Machine Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco HyperFlex HX Installer Virtual Machine contains an insufficient input validation vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute commands on an affected device as the root user.

advisories.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an insufficient input validation vulnerability for user-supplied input by the web services interface.  Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform cross-site scripting (XSS) in the context of the interface or access sensitive browser-based information.

advisories.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Read-Only Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an improper input validation vulnerability when HTTP requests process URLs.  An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted HTTP request containing directory traversal character sequences to an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view arbitrary files within the web services file system on the targeted device.

advisories.title: BQE BillQuick Web Suite SQL Injection Vulnerability

advisories.title: Atlassian Crowd and Crowd Data Center Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

advisories.summary: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Server contain an Object-Graph Navigation Language (OGNL) injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code.

advisories.title: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center Path Traversal Vulnerability

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability which can allow for code execution.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free Vulnerability

advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a memory corruption vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and iPadOS Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and iPadOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

advisories.title: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The Red Hat polkit pkexec utility contains an out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation with administrative rights.

advisories.title: Google Chromium PopupBlocker Security Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium PopupBlocker contains an insufficient policy enforcement vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to bypass navigation restrictions via a crafted iframe. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Mitel MiVoice Connect Data Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows LSA Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Local Security Authority (LSA) contains a spoofing vulnerability where an attacker can coerce the domain controller to authenticate to the attacker using NTLM.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Client Server Runtime Subsystem (CSRSS) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows CSRSS contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation to SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Atlassian Questions For Confluence App has hard-coded credentials, exposing the username and password in plaintext. A remote unauthenticated attacker can use these credentials to log into Confluence and access all content accessible to users in the confluence-users group.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

advisories.title: RARLAB UnRAR Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: RARLAB UnRAR on Linux and UNIX contains a directory traversal vulnerability, allowing an attacker to write to files during an extract (unpack) operation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when Microsoft Windows MSDT is called using the URL protocol from a calling application.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in MailboxImportServlet. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-27925 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains multiple, unspecified vulnerabilities which can allow for remote code execution when chained.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Runtime Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Runtime contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: An authenticated user could manipulate attributes on computer accounts they own or manage, and acquire a certificate from Active Directory Certificate Services that would allow for privilege escalation to SYSTEM.

advisories.title: Google Chromium Intents Insufficient Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium Intents contains an insufficient validation of untrusted input vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to browse to a malicious website via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution when processing malicious crafted web content.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow an application to execute code with kernel privileges.

advisories.title: SAP Multiple Products HTTP Request Smuggling Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java, ABAP Platform, SAP Content Server and SAP Web Dispatcher allow HTTP request smuggling. An unauthenticated attacker can prepend a victim's request with arbitrary data, allowing for function execution impersonating the victim or poisoning intermediary Web caches.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Reflected Amplification Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
advisories.summary: A Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS URL filtering policy misconfiguration could allow a network-based attacker to conduct reflected and amplified TCP denial-of-service (RDoS) attacks.

advisories.title: PEAR Archive_Tar Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PEAR Archive_Tar allows an unserialization attack because phar: is blocked but PHAR: is not blocked. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

advisories.title: PEAR Archive_Tar Improper Link Resolution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

advisories.title: Apple iOS, macOS, watchOS Sandbox Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: In affected versions of Apple iOS, macOS, and watchOS, a sandboxed process may be able to circumvent sandbox restrictions.

advisories.title: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Delta Electronics DOPSoft 2 lacks proper validation of user-supplied data when parsing specific project files (improper input validation) resulting in an out-of-bounds write that allows for code execution.

advisories.title: Grafana Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Grafana contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated and unauthenticated users to view and delete all snapshot data, potentially resulting in complete snapshot data loss.

advisories.title: WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

advisories.title: VMware Tanzu Spring Cloud Function Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: When using routing functionality in VMware Tanzu's Spring Cloud Function, it is possible for a user to provide a specially crafted SpEL as a routing-expression that may result in remote code execution and access to local resources.

advisories.title: Apache APISIX Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache APISIX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Apache CouchDB Insecure Default Initialization of Resource Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache CouchDB contains an insecure default initialization of resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to escalate to administrative privileges.

advisories.title: dotCMS Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
advisories.summary: dotCMS ContentResource API contains an unrestricted upload of file with a dangerous type vulnerability that allows for directory traversal, in which the file is saved outside of the intended storage location. Exploitation allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Android OS Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The vold volume manager daemon in Android kernel trusts messages from a PF_NETLINK socket, which allows an attacker to execute code and gain root privileges. This vulnerability is associated with GingerBreak and Exploit.AndroidOS.Lotoor.

advisories.title: D-Link DIR-300 Router Cleartext Storage of a Password Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The D-Link DIR-300 router stores cleartext passwords, which allows context-dependent attackers to obtain sensitive information.

advisories.title: NETGEAR Multiple Devices Exposure of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple NETGEAR devices are prone to admin password disclosure via simple crafted requests to the web management server.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC contain an improper access control vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain the LDAP server login credentials configured in FortiGate by pointing a LDAP server connectivity test request to a rogue LDAP server.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated attacker with T3 network access to compromise the server.

advisories.title: D-Link Multiple Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple D-Link routers contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for execution of OS commands.

advisories.title: MikroTik RouterOS Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: In MikroTik RouterOS, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs when processing NetBIOS session request messages. Remote attackers with access to the service can exploit this vulnerability and gain code execution on the system.

advisories.title: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an unspecified vulnerability involving input validation which can allow a local attacker to view sensitive user information.

advisories.title: D-Link DIR-820L Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DIR-820L contains an unspecified vulnerability in Device Name parameter in /lan.asp which allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: QNAP Photo Station Externally Controlled Reference Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Certain QNAP NAS running Photo Station with internet exposure contain an externally controlled reference to a resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to modify system files. This vulnerability was observed being utilized in a Deadbolt ransomware campaign.

advisories.title: Google Chromium Mojo Insufficient Data Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium Mojo contains an insufficient data validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple kernel, which is included in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, contains an unspecified vulnerability where an application may be able to execute code with kernel privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows incorrectly parses shortcuts in such a way that malicious code may be executed when the operating system displays the icon of a malicious shortcut file. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could execute code as the logged-on user.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux kernel fails to check all 64 bits of attr.config passed by user space, resulting to out-of-bounds access of the perf_swevent_enabled array in sw_perf_event_destroy(). Explotation allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Integer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux kernel fb_mmap function in drivers/video/fbmem.c contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Code Aurora ACDB Audio Driver Stack-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The Code Aurora audio calibration database (acdb) audio driver contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. Code Aurora is used in third-party products such as Qualcomm and Android.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The get_user and put_user API functions of the Linux kernel fail to validate the target address when being used on ARM v6k/v7 platforms. This allows an application to read and write kernel memory which could lead to privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Apex One and Apex One as a Service Improper Validation Vulnerability
advisories.product: Apex One and Apex One as a Service
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One and Apex One as a Service contain an improper validation of rollback mechanism components that could lead to remote code execution.

advisories.title: Zoho ManageEngine Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zoho ManageEngine PAM360, Password Manager Pro, and Access Manager Plus contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Sophos Firewall Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: A code injection vulnerability in the User Portal and Webadmin of Sophos Firewall allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple API endpoints of Atlassian Bitbucket Server and Data Center contain a command injection vulnerability where an attacker with access to a public Bitbucket repository, or with read permissions to a private one, can execute code by sending a malicious HTTP request.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server allows for server-side request forgery. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082 which allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution. Dubbed "ProxyNotShell," this vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41040 which allows for the remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows COM+ Event System Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows COM+ Event System Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform operations on the administrative interface via specially crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The overlayfs stacking file system in Linux kernel does not properly validate the application of file capabilities against user namespaces, which could lead to privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to upload arbitrary files using cpio package to gain incorrect access to any other user accounts.

advisories.title: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

advisories.title: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

advisories.title: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read/write data from/to IO ports. This could be leveraged in a number of ways to ultimately run code with elevated privileges.

advisories.title: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

advisories.title: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows Uncontrolled Search Path Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows allows for incorrect handling of directory paths. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows would be able to copy malicious files to arbitrary locations with system level privileges. This could include DLL pre-loading, DLL hijacking, and other related attacks.

advisories.title: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows DLL Hijacking Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows interprocess communication (IPC) channel allows for insufficient validation of resources that are loaded by the application at run time. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows could execute code on the affected machine with SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and iPadOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and iPadOS kernel contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability which can allow an application to perform code execution with kernel privileges.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.summary: Samsung mobile devices using Mali GPU contain an incorrect implementation handling file descriptor in dpu driver. This incorrect implementation results in memory corruption, leading to kernel panic. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25337 and CVE-2021-25369.

advisories.title: Samsung Mobile Devices Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Samsung mobile devices using Mali GPU contains an improper access control vulnerability in sec_log file. Exploitation of the vulnerability exposes sensitive kernel information to the userspace. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25337 and CVE-2021-25370.

advisories.title: Samsung Mobile Devices Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Samsung mobile devices contain an improper access control vulnerability in clipboard service which allows untrusted applications to read or write arbitrary files. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2021-25369 and CVE-2021-25370.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Scripting Languages Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability in the JScript9 scripting language which allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows CNG Key Isolation Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Cryptographic Next Generation (CNG) Key Isolation Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

advisories.summary: Google Chromium GPU contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. advisories.title: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability

advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.summary: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

advisories.title: Veeam Backup & Replication Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

advisories.summary: Citrix Application Delivery Controller (ADC) and Gateway, when configured with SAML SP or IdP configuration, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code as administrator.

advisories.title: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiOS Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple versions of Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specifically crafted requests.

advisories.title: Apple iOS Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS contains a type confusion vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content leading to code execution.

advisories.title: TIBCO JasperReports Library Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

advisories.title: TIBCO JasperReports Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TIBCO JasperReports Server contain a vulnerability which may allow any authenticated user read-only access to the contents of the web application, including key configuration files.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call (ALPC) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. This vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082, which allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: CWP Control Web Panel OS Command Injection Vulnerability

advisories.title: Ignite Realtime Openfire Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ignite Realtime Openfire contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to access restricted pages in the Openfire Admin Console reserved for administrative users.

advisories.title: RARLAB WinRAR Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: RARLAB WinRAR contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute code when a user attempts to view a benign file within a ZIP archive.

advisories.title: Apache RocketMQ Command Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Several components of Apache RocketMQ, including NameServer, Broker, and Controller, are exposed to the extranet and lack permission verification. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by using the update configuration function to execute commands as the system users that RocketMQ is running as or achieve the same effect by forging the RocketMQ protocol content.

advisories.title: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS Wallet Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability due to a validation issue affecting Wallet in which a maliciously crafted attachment may result in code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41064.

advisories.title: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

advisories.title: Microsoft Streaming Service Proxy Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Streaming Service Proxy contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Word Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Word contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

advisories.title: Google Chromium WebP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium WebP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to perform an out-of-bounds memory write via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability can affect applications that use the WebP Codec.

advisories.title: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense Unauthorized Access Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance and Firepower Threat Defense contain an unauthorized access vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to conduct a brute force attack in an attempt to identify valid username and password combinations or establish a clientless SSL VPN session with an unauthorized user.

advisories.title: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows for code execution.

advisories.title: Laravel Ignition File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Laravel Ignition contains a file upload vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute malicious code due to insecure usage of file_get_contents() and file_put_contents().

advisories.title: Zyxel EMG2926 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zyxel EMG2926 routers contain a command injection vulnerability located in the diagnostic tools, specifically the nslookup function. A malicious user may exploit numerous vectors to execute malicious commands on the router, such as the ping_ip parameter to the expert/maintenance/diagnostic/nslookup URI.

advisories.title: Realtek SDK Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Realtek SDK contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the miniigd SOAP service that allows remote attackers to execute malicious code via a crafted NewInternalClient request.

advisories.title: Samsung Mobile Devices Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Samsung devices with selected Exynos chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability that allows malicious memory write and code execution.

advisories.title: MinIO Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: MinIO contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to use crafted requests to bypass metadata bucket name checking and put an object into any bucket while processing `PostPolicyBucket` to conduct privilege escalation. To carry out this attack, the attacker requires credentials with `arn:aws:s3:::*` permission, as well as enabled Console API access.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Apex One and Worry-Free Business Security Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.product: Apex One and Worry-Free Business Security
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One and Worry-Free Business Security contain an unspecified vulnerability in the third-party anti-virus uninstaller that could allow an attacker to manipulate the module to conduct remote code execution. An attacker must first obtain administrative console access on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain an unspecified vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability that can allow a malicious app to bypass signature validation.

advisories.title: Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework Expression Language Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Red Hat JBoss RichFaces Framework contains an expression language injection vulnerability via the UserResource resource. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute malicious code using a chain of Java serialized objects via org.ajax4jsf.resource.UserResource$UriData.

advisories.title: Google Chromium libvpx Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium libvpx contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in vp8 encoding that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using libvpx, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

advisories.title: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local, non-privileged user to make improper GPU memory processing operations to gain access to already freed memory.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows CNG Key Isolation Service Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Cryptographic Next Generation (CNG) Key Isolation Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain specific limited SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: JetBrains TeamCity Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JetBrains TeamCity contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution on TeamCity Server.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and iPadOS Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and iPadOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for local privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Progress WS_FTP Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress WS_FTP Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the Ad Hoc Transfer module that allows an authenticated attacker to execute remote commands on the underlying operating system.

advisories.title: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server Broken Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to create unauthorized Confluence administrator accounts and access Confluence.

advisories.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack Vulnerability
advisories.summary: HTTP/2 contains a rapid reset vulnerability that allows for a distributed denial-of-service attack (DDoS).

advisories.title: Microsoft WordPad Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft WordPad contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

advisories.title: Microsoft Skype for Business Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Skype for Business contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Group Encrypted Transport VPN Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS and IOS XE contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Group Encrypted Transport VPN (GET VPN) feature that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker who has administrative control of either a group member or a key server to execute malicious code or cause a device to crash.

advisories.title: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution in the context of the current user.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS XE Web UI contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the web user interface that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create an account with privilege level 15 access. The attacker can then use that account to gain control of the affected device.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for sensitive information disclosure when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS XE contains a command injection vulnerability in the web user interface. When chained with CVE-2023-20198, the attacker can leverage the new local user to elevate privilege to root and write the implant to the file system. Cisco identified CVE-2023-20273 as the vulnerability exploited to deploy the implant. CVE-2021-1435, previously associated with the exploitation events, is no longer believed to be related to this activity.

advisories.title: Roundcube Webmail Persistent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

advisories.title: F5 BIG-IP Configuration Utility Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: F5 BIG-IP Configuration utility contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability due to undisclosed requests that may allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the BIG-IP system through the management port and/or self IP addresses to execute system commands. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-46748.

advisories.title: F5 BIG-IP Configuration Utility SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: F5 BIG-IP Configuration utility contains an SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with network access through the BIG-IP management port and/or self IP addresses to execute system commands. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-46747.

advisories.title: Apache ActiveMQ Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
