advisories.summary: Apache ActiveMQ contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker with network access to a broker to run shell commands by manipulating serialized class types in the OpenWire protocol to cause the broker to instantiate any class on the classpath.

advisories.title: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server Improper Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server contain an improper authorization vulnerability that can result in significant data loss when exploited by an unauthenticated attacker. There is no impact on confidentiality since the attacker cannot exfiltrate any data.

advisories.title: Service Location Protocol (SLP) Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The Service Location Protocol (SLP) contains a denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to register services and use spoofed UDP traffic to conduct a denial-of-service (DoS) attack with a significant amplification factor.

advisories.title: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to webauth_operation.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

advisories.title: Juniper Junos OS EX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to installAppPackage.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

advisories.title: Juniper Junos OS SRX Series Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Juniper Junos OS on SRX Series contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to cause limited impact to the file system integrity. With a specific request to user.php that doesn't require authentication, an attacker is able to upload arbitrary files via J-Web, leading to a loss of integrity for a certain part of the file system, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

advisories.title: Juniper Junos OS EX Series and SRX Series PHP External Variable Modification Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series and SRX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control an important environment variable. Using a crafted request, which sets the variable PHPRC, an attacker is able to modify the PHP execution environment allowing the injection und execution of code.

advisories.title: Juniper Junos OS EX Series PHP External Variable Modification Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control certain, important environment variables. Using a crafted request an attacker is able to modify certain PHP environment variables, leading to partial loss of integrity, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

advisories.title: SysAid Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SysAid Server (on-premises version) contains a path traversal vulnerability that leads to code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Cloud Files Mini Filter Driver contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass Windows Defender SmartScreen checks and their associated prompts.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Desktop Window Manager (DWM) Core Library contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Oracle Fusion Middleware Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle Fusion Middleware contains an unspecified vulnerability in the WLS Core Components that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via IIOP to compromise the WebLogic Server.

advisories.title: Sophos Web Appliance Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Sophos Web Appliance contains a command injection vulnerability in the warn-proceed handler that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a security feature bypass vulnerability resulting in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features.

advisories.title: GNU C Library Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

advisories.title: ownCloud graphapi Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ownCloud graphapi contains an information disclosure vulnerability that can reveal sensitive data stored in phpinfo() via GetPhpInfo.php, including administrative credentials.

advisories.title: Google Skia Integer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium Skia contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a malicious file. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that may disclose sensitive information when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and Safari WebKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability when process shell memory is freed using IOCTL munmap call and process initialization is in progress.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to memory corruption in DSP Services during a remote call from HLOS to DSP.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use of Out-of-Range Pointer Offset Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use of out-of-range pointer offset vulnerability due to memory corruption in Graphics while submitting a large list of sync points in an AUX command to the IOCTL_KGSL_GPU_AUX_COMMAND.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Integer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain an integer overflow vulnerability due to memory corruption in Graphics Linux while assigning shared virtual memory region during IOCTL call.

advisories.title: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

advisories.title: Qlik Sense Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Qlik Sense contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create an anonymous session by sending maliciously crafted HTTP requests. This anonymous session could allow the attacker to send further requests to unauthorized endpoints.

advisories.title: Unitronics Vision PLC and HMI Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Unitronics Vision Series PLCs and HMIs ship with an insecure default password, which if left unchanged, can allow attackers to execute remote commands.

advisories.title: QNAP VioStor NVR OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: QNAP VioStar NVR contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

advisories.title: FXC AE1021, AE1021PE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: FXC AE1021 and AE1021PE contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute commands via a network.

advisories.title: Google Chromium WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could impact web browsers using WebRTC, including but not limited to Google Chrome.

advisories.title: Spreadsheet::ParseExcel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Spreadsheet::ParseExcel contains a remote code execution vulnerability due to passing unvalidated input from a file into a string-type “eval”. Specifically, the issue stems from the evaluation of Number format strings within the Excel parsing logic.

advisories.title: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for code execution.

advisories.title: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for code execution.

advisories.title: Apache Superset Insecure Default Initialization of Resource Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache Superset contains an insecure default initialization of a resource vulnerability that allows an attacker to authenticate and access unauthorized resources on installations that have not altered the default configured SECRET_KEY according to installation instructions.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for code execution when processing a font file.

advisories.title: D-Link DSL-2750B Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DSL-2750B devices contain a command injection vulnerability that allows remote, unauthenticated command injection via the login.cgi cli parameter.

advisories.title: Joomla! Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Joomla! contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthorized access to webservice endpoints.

advisories.title: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure contain a command injection vulnerability in the web components of these products, which can allow an authenticated administrator to send crafted requests to execute code on affected appliances. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2023-46805, an authenticated bypass issue.

advisories.title: Ivanti Connect Secure and Policy Secure Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure) and Ivanti Policy Secure gateways contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web component that allows an attacker to access restricted resources by bypassing control checks. This vulnerability can be leveraged in conjunction with CVE-2024-21887, a command injection vulnerability.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker, who has gained access to spoofed JWT authentication tokens, to use them for executing a network attack. This attack bypasses authentication, enabling the attacker to gain administrator privileges.

advisories.title: Laravel Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Laravel Framework contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, allowing for remote command execution. This vulnerability may only be exploited if a malicious user has accessed the application encryption key (APP_KEY environment variable).

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a code injection vulnerability that allows for authenticated remote code execution on the management interface with access to NSIP, CLIP, or SNIP.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Memory Access Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and MobileIron Core Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.product: Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and MobileIron Core
advisories.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) and MobileIron Core contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthorized users to access restricted functionality or resources of the application.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter Server contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products WebKit Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and Safari WebKit contain a type confusion vulnerability that leads to code execution when processing maliciously crafted web content. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

advisories.title: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server Template Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server contain an unauthenticated OGNL template injection vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution.

advisories.title: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.product: Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and Neurons
advisories.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS, formerly known as Pulse Connect Secure), Ivanti Policy Secure, and Ivanti Neurons contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the SAML component that allows an attacker to access certain restricted resources without authentication.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS contain a time-of-check/time-of-use (TOCTOU) memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker with read and write capabilities to bypass Pointer Authentication.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiOS Out-of-Bound Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS contains an out-of-bound write vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute code or commands via specially crafted HTTP requests.

advisories.title: Roundcube Webmail Persistent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that can lead to information disclosure via malicious link references in plain/text messages.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the SmartScreen user experience and inject code to potentially gain code execution, which could lead to some data exposure, lack of system availability, or both.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Internet Shortcut Files contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an information disclosure vulnerability. An attacker could retrieve memory contents on an affected device, which could lead to the disclosure of confidential information due to a buffer tracking issue when the software parses invalid URLs that are requested from the web services interface. This vulnerability affects only specific AnyConnect and WebVPN configurations.

advisories.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to the management interface to create a new, administrator-level account on affected devices.

advisories.title: Microsoft Streaming Service Untrusted Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Streaming Service contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Kernel Exposed IOCTL with Insufficient Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an exposed IOCTL with insufficient access control vulnerability within the IOCTL (input and output control) dispatcher in appid.sys that allows a local attacker to achieve privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Sunhillo SureLine OS Command Injection Vulnerablity
advisories.summary: Sunhillo SureLine contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to cause a denial-of-service or utilize the device for persistence on the network via shell metacharacters in ipAddr or dnsAddr in /cgi/networkDiag.cgi.

advisories.title: Android Pixel Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Pixel contains a vulnerability in the Framework component, where the UI may be misleading or insufficient, providing a means to hide a foreground service notification. This could enable a local attacker to disclose sensitive information.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS RTKit contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker with arbitrary kernel read and write capability to bypass kernel memory protections.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS kernel contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows an attacker with arbitrary kernel read and write capability to bypass kernel memory protections.

advisories.title: JetBrains TeamCity Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JetBrains TeamCity contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform admin actions.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiClient EMS SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as SYSTEM via specifically crafted requests.

advisories.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Cloud Service Appliance (EPM CSA) Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.product: Endpoint Manager Cloud Service Appliance (EPM CSA)
advisories.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Cloud Service Appliance (EPM CSA) contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute malicious code with limited permissions (nobody).

advisories.title: Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker with Site Owner privileges to execute code remotely.

advisories.title: Android Pixel Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Pixel contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the fastboot firmware used to support unlocking, flashing, and locking affected devices.

advisories.title: Android Pixel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Pixel contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to interrupt a factory reset triggered by a device admin app.

advisories.title: D-Link Multiple NAS Devices Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L, and DNS-340L contains a hard-coded credential that allows an attacker to conduct authenticated command injection, leading to remote, unauthorized code execution.

advisories.title: D-Link Multiple NAS Devices Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L, and DNS-340L contain a command injection vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2024-3272, this can lead to remote, unauthorized code execution.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect feature contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands with root privileges on the firewall.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler service contains a privilege escalation vulnerability. An attacker may modify a JavaScript constraints file and execute it with SYSTEM-level permissions.

advisories.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Denial of Service Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an infinite loop vulnerability that can lead to remote denial of service condition.

advisories.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow local privilege escalation from Administrator to root.

advisories.title: CrushFTP VFS Sandbox Escape Vulnerability
advisories.summary: CrushFTP contains an unspecified sandbox escape vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to escape the CrushFTP virtual file system (VFS).

advisories.title: Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the Mark of the Web (MotW) feature. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-38831 and CVE-2024-21412 to execute a malicious file.

advisories.title: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions contain an improper access control vulnerability. This allows an attacker to trigger password reset emails to be sent to an unverified email address to ultimately facilitate an account takeover.

advisories.title: Google Chromium Visuals Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium Visuals contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Microsoft DWM Core Library Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft DWM Core Library contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a security feature bypass.

advisories.title: D-Link DIR-600 Router Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DIR-600 routers contain a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability that allows an attacker to change router configurations by hijacking an existing administrator session.

advisories.title: D-Link DIR-605 Router Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DIR-605 routers contain an information disclosure vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain a username and password by forging a post request to the /getcfg.php page.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Memory Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution via a specially crafted request.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page.

advisories.title: Apache Flink Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache Flink contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to read any file on the local filesystem of the JobManager through its REST interface.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) Viewer Installer Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) Viewer installer contains a malicious version of ffmpeg.exe, named fffmpeg.exe (SHA256: 421a4ad2615941b177b6ec4ab5e239c14e62af2ab07c6df1741e2a62223223c4). When run, this creates a backdoor connection to a malicious C2 server.

advisories.title: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Check Point Quantum Security Gateways contain an unspecified information disclosure vulnerability. The vulnerability potentially allows an attacker to access information on Gateways connected to the internet, with IPSec VPN, Remote Access VPN or Mobile Access enabled. This issue affects several product lines from Check Point, including CloudGuard Network, Quantum Scalable Chassis, Quantum Security Gateways, and Quantum Spark Appliances.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the netfilter: nf_tables component that allows an attacker to achieve local privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via a specially crafted HTTP request that includes a malicious XML document.

advisories.title: Arm Mali GPU Kernel Driver Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Arm Bifrost and Valhall GPU kernel drivers contain a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local, non-privileged user to make improper GPU memory processing operations to gain access to already freed memory.

advisories.title: PHP-CGI OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PHP, specifically Windows-based PHP used in CGI mode, contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability is a patch bypass for CVE-2012-1823.

advisories.title: Android Pixel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Pixel contains an unspecified vulnerability in the firmware that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Progress Telerik Report Server Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress Telerik Report Server contains an authorization bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows an attacker to obtain unauthorized access.

advisories.title: OSGeo GeoServer JAI-EXT Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: OSGeo GeoServer JAI-EXT contains a code injection vulnerability that, when programs use jt-jiffle and allow Jiffle script to be provided via network request, could allow remote code execution.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the nft_object, allowing local attackers to escalate privileges.

advisories.title: Roundcube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Roundcube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to manipulate data via a malicious XML attachment.

advisories.title: Cisco NX-OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco NX-OS contains a command injection vulnerability in the command line interface (CLI) that could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a spoofing vulnerability that has a high impact to confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Rejetto HTTP File Server Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Rejetto HTTP File Server contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability. This allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands on the affected system by sending a specially crafted HTTP request.

advisories.title: OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools Eval Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: OSGeo GeoServer GeoTools contains an improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code vulnerability due to unsafely evaluating property names as XPath expressions. This allows unauthenticated attackers to conduct remote code execution via specially crafted input.

advisories.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference (XXE) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper restriction of XML external entity reference (XXE) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Serv-U Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Serv-U contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker access to read sensitive files on the host machine.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Incorrect Default File Permissions Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter Server contains an incorrect default file permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, privileged attacker to gain access to sensitive information.

advisories.title: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted web site that triggers access to an object that (1) was not properly allocated or (2) is deleted, as demonstrated by a CDwnBindInfo object.

advisories.title: Twilio Authy Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Twilio Authy contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its API that allows an unauthenticated endpoint to accept a request containing a phone number and respond with information about whether the phone number was registered with Authy.

advisories.title: ServiceNow Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.product: Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
advisories.summary: ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform releases contain a jelly template injection vulnerability in UI macros. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

advisories.title: ServiceNow Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs Vulnerability
advisories.product: Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
advisories.summary: ServiceNow Washington DC, Vancouver, and earlier Now Platform releases contain an incomplete list of disallowed inputs vulnerability in the GlideExpression script. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

advisories.title: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) Insecure Default Password Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Acronis Cyber Infrastructure (ACI) allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands remotely due to the use of default passwords.

advisories.title: VMware ESXi Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.

advisories.title: Microsoft COM for Windows Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft COM for Windows contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation and remote code execution via a specially crafted file or script.

advisories.title: Android Kernel Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android contains an unspecified vulnerability in the kernel that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability resides in Linux Kernel and could impact other products, including but not limited to Android OS.

advisories.title: Apache OFBiz Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache OFBiz contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Project Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Project contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via a malicious file.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Scripting Engine contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attacker to initiate remote code execution via a specially crafted URL.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the SmartScreen user experience via a malicious file.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability requires an attacker to win a race condition.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Power Dependency Coordinator Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Power Dependency Coordinator contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to obtain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Jenkins Command Line Interface (CLI) Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Jenkins Command Line Interface (CLI) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers limited read access to certain files, which can lead to code execution.

advisories.title: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the NetKeyboard type argument is specified by the client during authentication.

advisories.title: Dahua IP Camera Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Dahua IP cameras and related products contain an authentication bypass vulnerability when the loopback device is specified by the client during authentication.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux kernel contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the legacy_parse_param function in the Filesystem Context functionality. This allows an attacker to open a filesystem that does not support the Filesystem Context API and ultimately escalate privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Versa Director Dangerous File Type Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: The Versa Director GUI contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows administrators with Provider-Data-Center-Admin or Provider-Data-Center-System-Admin privileges to customize the user interface. The “Change Favicon” (Favorite Icon) enables the upload of a .png file, which can be exploited to upload a malicious file with a .png extension disguised as an image.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Apache OFBiz Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache OFBiz contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow remote code execution via a Groovy payload in the context of the OFBiz user process by an unauthenticated attacker.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Inappropriate Implementation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains an inappropriate implementation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the DownloadFileServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

advisories.title: Draytek VigorConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Draytek VigorConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability in the file download functionality of the WebServlet endpoint. An unauthenticated attacker could leverage this vulnerability to download arbitrary files from the underlying operating system with root privileges.

advisories.title: Kingsoft WPS Office Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Kingsoft WPS Office contains a path traversal vulnerability in promecefpluginhost.exe on Windows that allows an attacker to load an arbitrary Windows library.

advisories.title: ImageMagick Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel PIE Stack Buffer Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux kernel contains a position-independent executable (PIE) stack buffer corruption vulnerability in load_elf_ binary() that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

advisories.title: SonicWall SonicOS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper access control vulnerability that could lead to unauthorized resource access and, under certain conditions, may cause the firewall to crash.

advisories.title: Microsoft Publisher Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Publisher contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows attacker to bypass Office macro policies used to block untrusted or malicious files.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Installer Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Installer contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Mark of the Web (MOTW) contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass MOTW-based defenses. This can result in a limited loss of integrity and availability of security features such as Protected View in Microsoft Office, which rely on MOTW tagging.

advisories.title: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a user interface (UI) misrepresentation of critical information vulnerability that allows an attacker to spoof a web page. This vulnerability was exploited in conjunction with CVE-2024-38112.

advisories.title: Progress WhatsUp Gold SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress WhatsUp Gold contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve the user's encrypted password if the application is configured with only a single user.

advisories.title: Adobe Flash Player Integer Underflow Vulnerablity
advisories.summary: Adobe Flash Player contains an integer underflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Adobe Flash Player Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Flash Player contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in the Firefox sandbox that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

advisories.title: Adobe Flash Player Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability in the ExternalInterface ActionScript functionality that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via crafted SWF content.

advisories.title: Adobe Flash Player Double Free Vulnerablity
advisories.summary: Adobe Flash Player contains a double free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Apache HugeGraph-Server Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache HugeGraph-Server contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SQL Server Reporting Services contains a deserialization vulnerability when handling page requests incorrectly. An authenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the Report Server service account.

advisories.title: Oracle ADF Faces Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle ADF Faces library, included with Oracle JDeveloper Distribution, contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability leading to unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains a deserialization vulnerability. Unauthenticated attackers with network access via T3 or IIOP can exploit this vulnerability to achieve remote code execution.

advisories.title: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to access restricted functionality. If CVE-2024-8963 is used in conjunction with CVE-2024-8190, an attacker could bypass admin authentication and execute arbitrary commands on the appliance.

advisories.title: Ivanti Virtual Traffic Manager Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Virtual Traffic Manager contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create a chosen administrator account.

advisories.title: D-Link DIR-820 Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DIR-820 routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ping_addr parameter to ping.ccp.

advisories.title: DrayTek Multiple Vigor Routers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: DrayTek Vigor3900, Vigor2960, and Vigor300B devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability in cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi/cvmcfgupload that allows for remote code execution via shell metacharacters in a filename when the text/x-python-script content type is used.

advisories.title: SAP Commerce Cloud Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud (formerly known as Hybris) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within the mediaconversion and virtualjdbc extension that allows for code injection.

advisories.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in Core server that allows an unauthenticated attacker within the same network to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an unspecified vulnerability in the postjournal service that may allow an unauthenticated user to execute commands.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to memory corruption in DSP Services while maintaining memory maps of HLOS memory.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Management Console Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Management Console contains unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified spoofing vulnerability which can lead to a loss of confidentiality.

advisories.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Format String Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain a format string vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

advisories.title: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the admin web console in versions prior to 5.0.2, which can allow a remote attacker authenticated as administrator to run arbitrary SQL statements.

advisories.title: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Kernel TOCTOU Race Condition Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Mozilla Firefox Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mozilla Firefox and Firefox ESR contain a use-after-free vulnerability in Animation timelines that allows for code execution in the content process.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Hardcoded Credential Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.

advisories.title: Veeam Backup and Replication Deserialization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

advisories.title: ScienceLogic SL1 Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ScienceLogic SL1 (formerly EM7) is affected by an unspecified vulnerability involving an unspecified third-party component.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiManager Missing Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiManager contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the fgfmd daemon that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

advisories.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
advisories.product: Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain a missing release of resource after effective lifetime vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of the RAVPN service.

advisories.title: RoundCube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

advisories.title: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ntp_addr parameter of the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script.

advisories.title: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a remote, attacker to bypass authentication for the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script. If combined with CVE-2024-8957, this can lead to remote code execution as root.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks Expedition Missing Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to takeover an Expedition admin account and potentially access configuration secrets, credentials, and other data.

advisories.title: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
advisories.summary: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute commands as root.

advisories.title: Nostromo nhttpd Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Nostromo nhttpd contains a directory traversal vulnerability in the http_verify() function in a non-chrooted nhttpd server allowing for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow an attacker-provided, local application to escalate privileges outside of its AppContainer, and access privileged RPC functions.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows NTLMv2 Hash Disclosure Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows contains an NTLMv2 hash spoofing vulnerability that could result in disclosing a user's NTLMv2 hash to an attacker via a file open operation. The attacker could then leverage this hash to impersonate that user.

advisories.title: Metabase GeoJSON API Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Metabase contains a local file inclusion vulnerability in the custom map support in the API to read GeoJSON formatted data.

advisories.title: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the WebVPN login page. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via an unspecified parameter.

advisories.title: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to read particular files in the /WEB-INF/web.xml endpoint.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks Expedition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary OS commands as root in Expedition, resulting in disclosure of usernames, cleartext passwords, device configurations, and device API keys of PAN-OS firewalls.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks Expedition SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to reveal Expedition database contents, such as password hashes, usernames, device configurations, and device API keys. With this, attackers can also create and read arbitrary files on the Expedition system.

advisories.title: Progress Kemp LoadMaster OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress Kemp LoadMaster contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system through the LoadMaster management interface, enabling arbitrary system command execution.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Management Interface Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web-based management interface for several PAN-OS products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Management Interface OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation through the web-based management interface for several PAN products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter Server contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the implementation of the DCERPC protocol. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to execute remote code by sending a specially crafted packet.

advisories.title: VMware vCenter Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: VMware vCenter contains an improper check for dropped privileges vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an attacker with network access to the vCenter Server to escalate privileges to root by sending a specially crafted packet.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain an unspecified vulnerability when processing maliciously crafted web content that may lead to a cross-site scripting (XSS) attack.

advisories.title: Oracle Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Process Extension component of the Software Development Kit. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability may result in unauthenticated file disclosure.

advisories.title: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

advisories.title: North Grid Proself Improper Restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) Reference Vulnerability
advisories.summary: North Grid Proself Enterprise/Standard, Gateway, and Mail Sanitize contain an improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) reference vulnerability, which could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to conduct an XXE attack.

advisories.title: ProjectSend Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ProjectSend contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to enable unauthorized modification of the application's configuration via crafted HTTP requests to options.php. Successful exploitation allows attackers to create accounts, upload webshells, and embed malicious JavaScript.

advisories.title: Zyxel Multiple Firewalls Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Zyxel firewalls contain a path traversal vulnerability in the web management interface that could allow an attacker to download or upload files via a crafted URL.

advisories.title: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
advisories.summary: CyberPanel contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and the execution of arbitrary commands using shell metacharacters in the statusfile property.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

advisories.title: Cleo Multiple Products Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom, which are managed file transfer products, contain an unrestricted file upload and download vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution with elevated privileges.

advisories.title: Adobe ColdFusion Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe ColdFusion contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access or modify restricted files via an internet-exposed admin panel.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Kernel-Mode Driver Untrusted Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Kernel-Mode Driver contains an untrusted pointer dereference vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges.

advisories.title: Cleo Multiple Products Unauthenticated File Upload Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cleo Harmony, VLTrader, and LexiCom, which are managed file transfer products, contain an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to import and execute arbitrary bash or PowerShell commands on the host system by leveraging the default settings of the Autorun directory.

advisories.title: NUUO NVRmini Devices OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: NUUO NVRmini devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote command execution via shell metacharacters in the uploaddir parameter for a writeuploaddir command.

advisories.title: NUUO NVRmini2 Devices Missing Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: NUUO NVRmini2 devices contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload an encrypted TAR archive, which can be abused to add arbitrary users.

advisories.title: Reolink Multiple IP Cameras OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Reolink RLC-410W, C1 Pro, C2 Pro, RLC-422W, and RLC-511W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability allows an authenticated admin to use the "TestEmail" functionality to inject and run OS commands as root.

advisories.title: Reolink RLC-410W IP Camera OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Reolink RLC-410W IP cameras contain an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the device network settings functionality.

advisories.title: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
advisories.summary: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain a command injection vulnerability, which can allow an unauthenticated attacker to inject commands that are run as a site user.

advisories.title: Acclaim Systems USAHERDS Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Acclaim Systems USAHERDS contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an attacker to achieve remote code execution on the system that runs the application. The MachineKey must be obtained via a separate vulnerability or other channel.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Malicious DNS Packet Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a vulnerability in parsing and logging malicious DNS packets in the DNS Security feature that, when exploited, allows an unauthenticated attacker to remotely reboot the firewall. Repeated attempts to trigger this condition will cause the firewall to enter maintenance mode.

advisories.title: Mitel MiCollab Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized and unauthenticated access. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-55550, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

advisories.title: Mitel MiCollab Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with administrative privileges to read local files within the system due to insufficient input sanitization. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2024-41713, which allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files on the server.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains an unspecified vulnerability exploitable by an unauthenticated attacker with network access via IIOP or T3.

advisories.title: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.product: Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways
advisories.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure, Policy Secure, and ZTA Gateways contain a stack-based buffer overflow which can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
advisories.summary: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

advisories.title: Qlik Sense HTTP Tunneling Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Qlik Sense contains an HTTP tunneling vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges and execute HTTP requests on the backend server hosting the software.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain super-admin privileges via crafted requests to Node.js websocket module.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Hyper-V NT Kernel Integration VSP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Aviatrix Controllers OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Aviatrix Controllers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code. Shell metacharacters can be sent to /v1/api in cloud_type for list_flightpath_destination_instances, or src_cloud_type for flightpath_connection_test.

advisories.title: JQuery Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JQuery contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. When passing maliciously formed, untrusted input enclosed in HTML tags, JQuery's DOM manipulators can execute untrusted code in the context of the user's browser.

advisories.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Deserialization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliance Management Console (AMC) and Central Management Console (CMC) contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability, which can enable a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and other Apple products contain a user-after-free vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to elevate privileges.

advisories.title: Apache OFBiz Forced Browsing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache OFBiz contains a forced browsing vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to obtain unauthorized access.

advisories.title: Microsoft .NET Framework Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft .NET Framework contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes the ObjRef URI to an attacker, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

advisories.title: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with administrative privileges to execute commands via the PRTG System Administrator web console.

advisories.title: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create users with read-write privileges (including administrator).

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the uvc_parse_streaming component of the USB Video Class (UVC) driver that could allow for physical escalation of privilege.

advisories.title: 7-Zip Mark of the Web Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: 7-Zip contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the Mark-of-the-Web security feature to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

advisories.title: Dante Discovery Process Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Microsoft Outlook Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Outlook contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability would allow an attacker to bypass the Office Protected View and open in editing mode rather than protected mode.

advisories.title: CyberoamOS (CROS) SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.

advisories.title: Sophos XG Firewall Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Sophos XG Firewall contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the "HTTP/S bookmark" feature.

advisories.title: Trimble Cityworks Deserialization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Trimble Cityworks contains a deserialization vulnerability. This could allow an authenticated user to perform a remote code execution attack against a customer's Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Storage Link Following Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Storage contains a link following vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to delete data including data that results in the service being unavailable.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the CGI program that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

advisories.title: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the management commands that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via Telnet.

advisories.title: Mitel SIP Phones Argument Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mitel 6800 Series, 6900 Series, and 6900w Series SIP Phones, including the 6970 Conference Unit, contain an argument injection vulnerability due to insufficient parameter sanitization during the boot process. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and iPadOS Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and iPadOS contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows a physical attacker to disable USB Restricted Mode on a locked device.

advisories.title: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

advisories.title: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the SSLVPN authentication mechanism that allows a remote attacker to bypass authentication.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its management web interface. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the management web interface to bypass the authentication normally required and invoke certain PHP scripts.

advisories.title: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability caused by improper validation of the database backup path, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS File Read Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability. Successful exploitation enables an authenticated attacker with network access to the management web interface to read files on the PAN-OS filesystem that are readable by the “nobody” user.

advisories.title: Microsoft Power Pages Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Power Pages contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network potentially bypassing the user registration control.

advisories.title: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization vulnerability in the Apache BlazeDS library that allows for arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: Oracle Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Deserialization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a low-privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise the system.

advisories.title: Microsoft Partner Center Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Partner Center contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges.
