advisories.summary: Microsoft Configuration Manager contains an SQL injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted requests to the target environment which are processed in an unsafe manner enabling the attacker to execute commands on the server and/or underlying database.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow an attacker with memory write the capability to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.product: Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)
advisories.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support (RS) and Privileged Remote Access (PRA)contain an OS command injection vulnerability. Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute operating system commands in the context of the site user. Successful exploitation requires no authentication or user interaction and may lead to system compromise, including unauthorized access, data exfiltration, and service disruption.

advisories.title: Google Chromium CSS Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium CSS contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Video ActiveX Control contains a remote code execution vulnerability. An attacker could exploit the vulnerability by constructing a specially crafted Web page. When a user views the Web page, the vulnerability could allow remote code execution. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could gain the same user rights as the logged-on user.

advisories.title: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TeamT5 ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. ThreatSonar Anti-Ransomware does not properly validate the content of uploaded files. Remote attackers with administrator privileges on the product platform can upload malicious files, which can be used to execute arbitrary system commands on the server.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability if WebEx zimlet installed and zimlet JSP is enabled.

advisories.title: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) contains an use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the underlying operating system and root-level persistence.

advisories.title: GitLab Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: GitLab contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability when requests to the internal network for webhooks are enabled.

advisories.title: RoundCube Webmail Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
advisories.summary: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability via the animate tag in an SVG document.

advisories.title: RoundCube Webmail Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: RoundCube Webmail contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows remote code execution by authenticated users because the _from parameter in a URL is not validated in program/actions/settings/upload.php.

advisories.title: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Soliton Systems K.K FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability when an user logs-in to the affected product and sends a specially crafted HTTP request.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller and Manager Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller, formerly SD-WAN vSmart, and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, formerly SD-WAN vManage, contain an authentication bypass vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system. This vulnerability exists because the peering authentication mechanism in an affected system is not working properly. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted requests to an affected system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to log in to an affected Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller as an internal, high-privileged, non-root user account. Using this account, the attacker could access NETCONF, which would then allow the attacker to manipulate network configuration for the SD-WAN fabric.

advisories.title: Cisco SD-WAN Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco SD-WAN CLI contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to gain elevated privileges via improper access controls on commands within the application CLI. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as the root user.

advisories.title: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Memory Corruption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a memory corruption vulnerability while using alignments for memory allocation.

advisories.title: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Broadcom VMware Aria Operations formerly known as vRealize Operations (vROps) contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands, potentially leading to remote code execution during support‑assisted product migration.

advisories.title: Apple iOS and iPadOS Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS and iPadOS contain a use-after-free vulnerability. An app may be able to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple tvOS, macOS, Safari, iPadOS and watchOS contain an integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability due to the processing of maliciously crafted web content that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple products Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and Safari 16.6 contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to the processing of maliciously crafted web content that may lead to memory corruption.

advisories.title: Rockwell Multiple Products Insufficient Protected Credentials Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Rockwell products contain an insufficient protected credentials vulnerability. Studio 5000 Logix Designer software may allow a key to be discovered. This key is used to verify Logix controllers are communicating with Rockwell Automation design software. If successfully exploited, this vulnerability could allow an unauthorized application to connect with Logix controllers. To leverage this vulnerability, an unauthorized user would require network access to the controller.

advisories.title: Hikvision Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Hikvision products contain an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a malicious user to escalate privileges on the system and gain access to sensitive information.

advisories.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak specific stored credential data.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in AjaxProxy that could allow an attacker to run commands on the host machine.

advisories.title: Omnissa Workspace ONE Server-Side Request Forgery
advisories.summary: Omnissa Workspace One UEM formerly known as VMware Workspace One UEM contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with network access to UEM to send their requests without authentication and to gain access to sensitive information.

advisories.title: n8n Improper Control of Dynamically-Managed Code Resources Vulnerability
advisories.summary: n8n contains an improper control of dynamically managed code resources vulnerability in its workflow expression evaluation system that allows for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Google Skia Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Skia contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability affects Google Chrome and ChromeOS, Android, Flutter, and possibly other products.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Improper Restriction of Operations Within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Wing FTP Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Wing FTP Server contains a generation of error message containing sensitive information vulnerability when using a long value in the UID cookie.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Classic UI where attackers could abuse Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) @import directives in email HTML.

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary Java code as root on an affected device.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple Safari, iOS, watchOS, visionOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow the processing of maliciously crafted web content which may lead to memory corruption.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Classic Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain a classic buffer overflow vulnerability which could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected system termination or write kernel memory.

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Improper Locking Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple watchOS, iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and tvOS contain an improper locking vulnerability that could allow a malicious application to cause unexpected changes in memory shared between processes.

advisories.title: Laravel Livewire Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Laravel Livewire contain a code injection vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote command execution in specific scenarios.

advisories.title: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow building public flows without requiring authentication.

advisories.title: Aquasecurity Trivy Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Aquasecurity Trivy contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that could allow an attacker to gain access to everything in the CI/CD environment, including all tokens, SSH keys, cloud credentials, database passwords, and any sensitive configuration in memory.

advisories.title: F5 BIG-IP Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow a threat actor to achieve remote code execution.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC), NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) and NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP contain an out-of-bounds reads vulnerability when configured as a SAML IDP leading to memory overread.

advisories.title: Google Dawn Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Dawn contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker who had compromised the renderer process to execute arbitrary code via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple Chromium-based products including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: TrueConf Client Download of Code Without Integrity Check Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TrueConf Client contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability. An attacker who is able to influence the update delivery path can substitute a tampered update payload. If the payload is executed or installed by the updater, this may result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the updating process or user.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiClient EMS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

advisories.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

advisories.title: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Prototype Pollution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiClient EMS SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

advisories.title: Adobe Acrobat Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Acrobat contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows for code execution

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Out-of-Bounds Read Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System Driver contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that could allow a threat actor for privileges escalation

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data that allows an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows contains a link following vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation

advisories.title: Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications Insecure Library Loading Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) contains an insecure library loading vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

advisories.title: Microsoft Office Remote Code Execution
advisories.summary: Microsoft Office Excel contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to take complete control of an affected system if a user opens a specially crafted Excel file that includes a malformed object.

advisories.title: Apache ActiveMQ Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache ActiveMQ contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for code injection.

advisories.title: JetBrains TeamCity Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JetBrains TeamCity contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow limited admin actions to be performed.

advisories.title: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Quest KACE Systems Management Appliance (SMA) contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow attackers to impersonate legitimate users without valid credentials.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Storing Passwords in a Recoverable Format Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a storing passwords in a recoverable format vulnerability that allows an authenticated, local attacker to gain DCA user privileges by accessing a credential file for the DCA user on the filesystem as a low-privileged user.

advisories.title: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-site Scripting Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary JavaScript within the user's session, potentially leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

advisories.title: PaperCut NG/MF Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PaperCut NG/MF contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations via the SecurityRequestFilter class.

advisories.title: Kentico Xperience Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Kentico Xperience contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user's Staging Sync Server to upload arbitrary data to path relative locations.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to view sensitive information on affected systems.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability due to improper file handling on the API interface of an affected system. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by uploading a malicious file on the local file system. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to overwrite arbitrary files on the affected system and gain vmanage user privileges.

advisories.title: Microsoft Defender Insufficient Granularity of Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Defender contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that could allow an authorized attacker to escalate privileges locally.

advisories.title: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

advisories.title: SimpleHelp Missing Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SimpleHelp contains a missing authorization vulnerability that could allow low-privileged technicians to create API keys with excessive permissions. These API keys can be used to escalate privileges to the server admin role.

advisories.title: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SimpleHelp contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows admin users to upload arbitrary files anywhere on the file system by uploading a crafted zip file (i.e. zip slip). This can be exploited to execute arbitrary code on the host in the context of the SimpleHelp server user.

advisories.title: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to write arbitrary files as system authority.

advisories.title: D-Link DIR-823X Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: D-Link DIR-823X contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to execute arbitrary commands on remote devices by sending a POST request to /goform/set_prohibiting via the corresponding function. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Protection Mechanism Failure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

advisories.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow an attacker to execute remote code or directly impact confidential data and critical systems.

advisories.title: WebPros cPanel & WHM and WP2 (WordPress Squared) Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WebPros cPanel & WHM (WebHost Manager) and WP2 (WordPress Squared) contain an authentication bypass vulnerability in the login flow that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain unauthorized access to the control panel.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains an incorrect resource transfer between spheres vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Out-of-bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the User-ID Authentication Portal (aka Captive Portal) service that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls by sending specially crafted packets.

advisories.title: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remotely authenticated user with administrative access to achieve remote code execution.

advisories.title: BerriAI LiteLLM SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to read data from the proxy's database and potentially modify it, leading to unauthorized access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller & Manager contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges on an affected system.

advisories.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Exchange Server contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability during web page generation in Outlook Web Access and when certain interaction conditions are met, arbitrary JavaScript can be executed in the browser context.

advisories.title: Microsoft Defender Denial of Service Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Defender contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for denial of service.

advisories.title: Microsoft Defender Link Following Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Defender contains a link following vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

advisories.title: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via vectors involving access to an invalid pointer after the deletion of an object. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

advisories.title: Microsoft Internet Explorer Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an use-after-free vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by accessing a pointer associated with a deleted object. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

advisories.title: Adobe Acrobat and Reader Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Acrobat and Reader contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted PDF file that triggers memory corruption.

advisories.title: Microsoft DirectX NULL Byte Overwrite Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft DirectX contains a NULL byte overwrite vulnerability in the QuickTime Movie Parser Filter in quartz.dll in DirectShow which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted QuickTime media file.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the Windows Server Service that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted RPC request that triggers an overflow during path canonicalization.

advisories.title: Trend Micro Apex One (On-Premise) Directory Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Trend Micro Apex One (on-premise) contains a directory traversal vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated local attacker to modify a key table on the server to inject malicious code to deploy to agents on affected installations.

advisories.title: Langflow Origin Validation Error Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Langflow contains an origin validation error vulnerability in which an overly permissive CORS configuration combined with a refresh token cookie configured as SameSite=None allows a malicious webpage to perform cross-origin requests that include credentials and successfully call the refresh endpoint. This could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code and achieve full system compromise via obtained tokens that permit access to authenticated endpoints.

advisories.title: Drupal Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

advisories.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

advisories.title: Daemon Tools Lite Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Daemon Tools contains an unspecified vulnerability that has a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

advisories.title: TanStack Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TanStack contains an unspecified vulnerability that allowed malicious versions of the product to be published to the npm registry to publish credential-stealing malware under a trusted identity.

advisories.title: Nx Console Embedded Malicious Code Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Nx Console contains an embedded malicious code vulnerability that allowed a malicious version of Nx Console to be published. The compromised extension fetched an obfuscated payload that could harvested credentials from multiple sources on disk and in memory.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection.

advisories.title: Oracle WebLogic Server Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle WebLogic contains an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3, IIOP to compromise Oracle WebLogic Server. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle WebLogic Server accessible data.

advisories.title: Android Framework Integer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Android Framework contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows for code execution that could allow for local privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow for privilege escalation via the cgroups v1 release_agent feature.

advisories.title: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

advisories.title: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

advisories.title: Check Point Security Gateway Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Check Point Security Gateway contains an improper authentication vulnerability in IKEv1 key exchange that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass user authentication and establish a remote access VPN connection without a valid user password.

advisories.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, to run arbitrary commands on the host.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager formerly SD-WAN vManage contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated, local attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root by supplying a crafted file to the affected system.

advisories.title: Arista Extensible Operating System Incomplete Comparison with Missing Factors Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Arista Extensible Operating System (EOS) contains an incomplete comparison with missing factors vulnerability when the switch incorrectly decapsulate and forwards other unexpected tunneled packet with a destination IP matching its configured decapsulation IP.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 out-of-bounds read and write vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Ivanti Sentry OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Sentry (formerly known as MobileIron Sentry) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthenticated user to achieve root-level remote code execution. This vulnerability can be successfully exploited in cases where the Sentry appliance is in an unmanaged state with its endpoints externally reachable. The use of mTLS with EPMM or restricted HTTPS access through Neurons for MDM makes interfaces inaccessible to external actors.

advisories.title: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to obtain takeover of PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Directory or Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a directory or path traversal vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to create a file or overwrite any file on the filesystem of an affected system.

advisories.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following Vulnerability
advisories.summary: LiteSpeed cPanel plugin contains a UNIX symbolic link (Symlink) following vulnerability that could allow a user with FTP or web shell access on a shared hosting server running CloudLinux/CageFS.

advisories.title: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

advisories.title: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

advisories.title: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

advisories.title: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to access files on the underlying system that could be manipulated to access an underlying account.

advisories.title: Ubiquiti UniFi OS Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper input validation vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to conduct command injection.

advisories.title: Lantronix EDS5000 Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

advisories.title: Cisco Unified Communications Manager Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Unified Communications Manager (Unified CM) and Cisco Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (Unified CM SME) contain a server-side request forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write files to the underlying operating system that could be used later to elevate to root.

advisories.title: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PTC Windchill and FlexPLM contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a malicious request to the network.

advisories.title: SimpleHelp Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SimpleHelp contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the OIDC authentication flow. When OIDC authentication is configured, identity tokens submitted during login are accepted without verifying their cryptographic signature. In a vulnerable configuration, a remote, unauthenticated attacker can submit a forged token containing arbitrary identity claims to obtain a fully authenticated technician session. In some configurations, this may also allow bypass of multi-factor authentication.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

advisories.title: Adobe ColdFusion Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe ColdFusion contains a path traversal vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user.

advisories.title: Joomlack Page Builder Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Joomlack Page Builder contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via unauthenticated arbitrary file upload.

advisories.title: Langflow Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Langflow contains an authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability which allows an authenticated attacker to execute any flow belonging to another user by specifying the victim's flow ID in the request.

advisories.title: JoomShaper SP Page Builder Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JoomShaper SP Page Builder contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files, ultimately resulting in the upload and execution of PHP code.

advisories.title: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
advisories.summary: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

advisories.title: Balbooa Forms Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

advisories.title: Cisco IOS Cross-Site Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco IOS 12.4 contains multiple cross-site forgery vulnerabilities that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via (1) a certain "show privilege" command to the /level/15/exec/- URI, and (2) a certain "alias exec" command to the /level/15/exec/-/configure/http URI.

advisories.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a code injection vulnerability which in specific conditions could potentially enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands.

advisories.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contain a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to potentially cause the appliance to make requests to unintended location.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

advisories.title: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services Insufficient Granularity of Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services contains an insufficient granularity of access control vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

advisories.title: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 Overly Restrictive Account Lockout Mechanism Vulnerability
advisories.summary: KNX Association KNX Protocol Connection Authorization Option 1 contains an overly restrictive account lockout mechanism vulnerability that could allow an attacker to purge all devices without additional security options enabled and set a BCU key to lock the device.

advisories.title: Oracle E-Business Suite Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Oracle E-Business Suite contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Payments. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Payments.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiSandbox, FortiSandbox Cloud, and FortiSandbox PaaS contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

advisories.title: DD-WRT Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: DD-WRT contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to overflow an internal buffer used by UPnP and trigger a code execution vulnerability.

advisories.title: Langflow Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Langflow contains an inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations.

advisories.title: WordPress Core Interpretation Conflict Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WordPress Core contains an interpretation conflict vulnerability that could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-60137.

advisories.title: WordPress Core SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WordPress Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability when a plugin or theme passes untrusted input to the parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-63030 to allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain remote code execution on default WordPress installations.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

advisories.title: Check Point SmartConsole Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Check Point SmartConsole contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an application login token and use it to authenticate with full administrative privileges.

advisories.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem contains an OS command injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS contains an exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor vulnerability. This may allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass the patch developed for the symbolic link persistency mechanism observed in some post-exploit cases, via crafted HTTP requests. An attacker would need first to have compromised the product via another vulnerability, at filesystem level.

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Use of Hard-coded Password Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) formerly known as Firepower Management Center contains a use of hard-coded password vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in to an affected device using a low-privileged account to access sensitive data within the impacted systems.

advisories.title: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
advisories.summary: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel allows for authentication bypass and account takeover in N-central. This vulnerability is the result of an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-18556.

advisories.title: IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full remote code execution on default Langflow deployments.

advisories.title: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.

advisories.title: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
advisories.summary: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

advisories.title: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

advisories.title: Progress LoadMaster Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Progress LoadMaster contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an un-authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the LoadMaster appliance by exploiting unsanitized input in multiple command endpoints.

advisories.title: Metabase SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Metabase contains a SQL Injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to inject arbitrary SQL into the Metabase application database, which can give them administrator access to the instance. From there, the attacker could change the application configuration, steal stored credentials for the connected databases, read any data accessible through those connections, and export data.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
advisories.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Heap Inspection Vulnerability
advisories.product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
advisories.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) contain a heap inspection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

advisories.title: Ray-Project Ray Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ray-Project Ray contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow remote code execution. Developers using Ray as a development tool may be exposed to this vulnerability exploitable through Firefox and Safari.

advisories.title: Apple macOS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Weak Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a weak authentication vulnerability which allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

advisories.title: Broadcom VMware vCenter Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains a path traversal vulnerability which could allow a threat actor with network access to vCenter to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions Double Free Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

advisories.title: MLflow Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

advisories.title: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.

advisories.title: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.

advisories.title: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

advisories.title: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.product: HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in
advisories.summary: Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in contain an improper access control vulnerability that can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data as well as unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server and Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data.

advisories.title: Gitea Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Gitea contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with repository write access to send a malicious patch to the diffpatch API endpoint to plant an executable Git hook and run shell commands as the Gitea service account.

advisories.title: Microsoft SQL Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SQL Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute code in the context of the SQL Server Database Engine service account.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds memory write vulnerability which could allow a local user to gain privileged access or cause a denial of service on the system.

advisories.title: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Red Hat Automatic Bug Reporting Tool (ABRT) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that could allow local users with certain permissions to gain privileges via a symlink attack on a file with a predictable name. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

advisories.title: Red Hat Libuser Race Condition Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Red Hat libuser contains a race condition vulnerability that allows authenticated local users to corrupt the /etc/passwd file to cause a denial of service or privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

advisories.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability. This can allow an authenticated user to write data outside the intended Docker cache path under specific remote-repository conditions.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Unspecified Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that can allow for privilege escalation via IPv6 networking subsystem. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to Suse, Red Hat, and other products using Linux.

advisories.title: ownCloud Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ownCloud contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker to access, modify, or delete any file without authentication if the username of a victim is known, and the victim has no signing-key configured.

advisories.title: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

advisories.title: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

advisories.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could enable a remote authenticated attacker as administrator to execute arbitrary OS commands, resulting in remote code execution.

advisories.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
advisories.summary: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

advisories.title: Sangoma Switchvox SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.

advisories.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

advisories.title: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

advisories.title: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

advisories.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

advisories.title: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

advisories.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

advisories.title: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
advisories.product: Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
advisories.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

advisories.title: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

advisories.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

advisories.title: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
advisories.summary: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

advisories.title: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
advisories.summary: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

advisories.title: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

advisories.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

advisories.title: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

advisories.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

advisories.title: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

advisories.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

advisories.title: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

advisories.title: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

advisories.title: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

advisories.title: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

advisories.title: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

advisories.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

advisories.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

advisories.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

advisories.title: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

advisories.title: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
advisories.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

advisories.title: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

advisories.title: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

advisories.title: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

advisories.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

advisories.title: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

advisories.title: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

advisories.title: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

advisories.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

advisories.title: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

advisories.title: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

advisories.title: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

advisories.title: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

advisories.title: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
advisories.summary: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

advisories.title: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

advisories.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

advisories.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

advisories.title: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

advisories.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

advisories.title: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

advisories.title: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

advisories.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
advisories.summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

advisories.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
advisories.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

advisories.title: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

advisories.title: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

advisories.title: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

advisories.title: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

advisories.title: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
advisories.summary: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

advisories.title: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
advisories.summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

advisories.title: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
